title: Be going to
summary: Use be going to for plans, intentions and predictions based on evidence.

explanation.en: Be going to is used for plans already decided and for predictions when there is evidence now.
explanation.ru: Be going to используется для уже принятых планов и прогнозов, основанных на видимых признаках.

examples.en: We are going to travel in July.
I'm not going to stay at home.

commonMistakes.right: I am going to visit Rome.
commonMistakes.note: Use a form of be before going to.

commonMistakes.wrong: She is going to visits us.
commonMistakes.right: She is going to visit us.
commonMistakes.note: Use the base verb after going to.
